fields.value: A witty and punny Haiku, but don't use the word "pun"

data.code:
"Generate an abstract full screen background image best suited for the current hour of the current day (24h format): " & now().format("dddd, yyyy-MM-dd HH") & "
We're located in: " & location & "
Also take inspiration from this " & textType & ":

" & reply

"Generate the following plain text (no quotes) based on the current hour of the current day (given in 24h format): " & now().format("dddd, yyyy-MM-dd HH") & ":00. Include at least the hour as a word in the reply. " & (if clockType == "12h": "Use the " & now().format("tt") & " format of the hour as a word in the text: " & now().format("hh") else: "Use the 24h format of the hour as a word in the text: " & now().format("HH")) & "\n. Use calendar seasonality for: " & location
data.codeJS:
`Generate the following plain text (no quotes) based on the current hour of the current day (given in 24h format): ${format(now(), '{weekday}, {year/4}-{month/2}-{day/2} {hour}/2')}:00. Include at least the hour as a word in the reply. ${clockType == '12h' ? 'Use the ' + format(now(), '{am/pm}') + ' format of the hour as a word in the text: ' : 'Use the 24h format of the hour as a word in the text: ' + format(now(), '{hour/2}')}
. Use calendar seasonality for: ${location}`

fields.name: saveAssets
fields.label: Save asset
fields.hint:
Save the generated image to disk as an asset. It'll be placed into the frame's assets folder.

You can later use the 'Local image' app to view saved assets.

If set to 'auto', the image will be saved if the frame is set to save assets. If set to 'always', the image will always be saved. If set to 'never', the image will never be saved.
